transcript:
Speaker A (AI Avatar): English na aane ki wajah se kitni baar jhukte hain aap? Hospital mein bhaiya please Hindi mein samjha do. Bank mein sir thoda aasan bhasha mein bata dijiye. Bacche ki school meeting mein chup khade rahe kyunki teacher English mein bol rahi thi. Hath jodna band karo, English seekhna shuru karo aur izzat se jeena shuru karo. Main hoon aapki AI teacher Vani, SpeakEasy app par, aur main aaj aapse ek baat kehne aayi hoon. English bolna aapka haq hai. Hindi medium se ho to kya hua, gaon se ho to kya hua, English pe kisi ek class ka theka nahi laga hua hai. Aur jo log kehte hain isko to English aati hi nahi, unhi logon ke samne ek din fluent English bologe na to unka muh band ho jayega. Par uske liye pehle galat bolna padega, toota hua bolna padega, thaklana padega, aur isliye main hoon. Mere samne bolo, 100 baar galat bolo, main kabhi nahi hansungi, kabhi nahi judge karungi, kabhi nahi bolungi itna bhi nahi aata. Main AI hoon, main thakti nahi, soti nahi aur tumhari beizzati kabhi nahi karti. Aur main 24 ghante available hoon practice ke liye, raat ke 2 baje bhi, subah ke 5 baje bhi. Jab aapko time mile tab mujhse baat karo, chat karo, practice karo. Dono sath milkar aapki English ko fluent banayenge. Yahan trial sirf ₹1 ka hai, ek chai se bhi sasta. To aaj ke baad koi aapko ignore kare to use English mein jawab dena. Par pehle SpeakEasy app download karo, aaj se, abhi se. Kyunki izzat mangne se nahi milti, English bolne se milti hai. [How many times do you bow down because you don't know English? Please explain in Hindi at the hospital. Please explain in simpler language at the bank. Stood silent at the child's school meeting because the teacher spoke English. Stop begging, start learning English and live with respect. I am your AI teacher Vani on the SpeakEasy app, and I am here to tell you one thing. Speaking English is your right. So what if you are from a Hindi medium or a village? English is not the monopoly of one class. And those who say you don't know English, their mouths will shut when you speak fluently in front of them. But for that, you must first speak incorrectly, brokenly, and stutter, and that's why I am here. Speak in front of me, make mistakes 100 times, I will never laugh, judge, or say you don't even know this much. I am AI, I don't get tired, sleep, or insult you. I am available 24 hours for practice, even at 2 AM or 5 AM. Talk, chat, and practice with me whenever you have time. Together we will make your English fluent. The trial here is just ₹1, cheaper than a cup of tea. So from now on, if anyone ignores you, answer them in English. But first, download the SpeakEasy app, from today, right now. Because respect is not begged for, it is earned by speaking English.]
Speaker B (Human): Abhi SpeakEasy app download karein aur farratedar English bolna shuru karein. [Download the SpeakEasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
